decision: one registered evidence view per query before outcomes
inference: Paired intervals resample all 1,636 support-title connected components with fold selections and submitted actions frozen.
privacy_boundary: The public IDs and questions remain joinable to the source 2Wiki dataset. The contract enforces evaluator timing and direct field separation; it is not cryptographic secrecy for public data.
raw_quality: binary support-title NDCG@4 after stable first-occurrence normalized-title deduplication within stored top-4; no backfill
reference_estimand: A_OOF: each query is scored once by a legal policy fitted without its support-title component and selected on a disjoint development fold. This is a cross-fitted procedure estimate, not one final deployed policy.
training_provenance: Action-vector scoring does not certify supervised fold isolation; ordinary submissions are marked training_provenance_unverified.
